snippet.title: Steel Artery - Official Launch Trailer | Steampunk Train City Builder
snippet.description:
Steel Artery is out now.

Build a living city on rails in this steampunk train city builder. Manage thousands of autonomous citizens, balance economy and logistics, and lead your moving empire across fractured lands.

Unlike traditional city builders, your citizens make their own choices, creating emergent stories and unexpected challenges.

🚂 Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602030/Steel_Artery_Train_City_Builder/
